title: Joining anchor-free runs
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a control state, let $c,d,f$ be configurations, and let $u,v$ be natural numbers. If the run from $c$ reaches $d$ after $u$ steps and avoids $a$ at every time from $0$ through $u$, and the run from $d$ reaches $f$ after $v$ steps and avoids $a$ at every time from $0$ through $v$, then the run from $c$ reaches $f$ after $u+v$ steps and avoids $a$ at every time from $0$ through $u+v$.
replaced:
If the run from $c$ reaches $d$ in exactly $u$ anchor-free steps and the run
from $d$ reaches $f$ in exactly $v$ anchor-free steps, then the run from $c$
reaches $f$ in exactly $u+v$ anchor-free steps.
